LESSON: PROPHECIES ABOUT THE MESSIAH

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Early life of Jesus Christ
Topic 4.1: Prophecies about the Messiah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prophecies about the Messiah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How were the Old Testament prophecies about the Messiah fulfilled?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

Teach
• Today’s focus: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies” using a school example.
• Model B for “value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Prophecies about the Messiah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How were the Old Testament prophecies about the Messiah fulfilled?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• value the fulfillment of the Old Testament prophecies

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
